---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What need or pain point is this solving? What can't you do today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Keep it as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or related issues. If this touches a security boundary,
storage/protocol choice, or a cross-cutting mechanism, note that it will likely
need an ADR (see `docs/adr/`).
